chunks: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir عليه السلام said:

If you shroud the deceased, and you are able to include in his shroud a garment in which he used to perform salat (prayer), clean, then do so, for it is recommended that he be shrouded in what he used to perform salat (prayer) in.

key_terms.ثَوْبٌ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.كَفَّنْتَ: you shrouded the deceased for burial

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to shroud the deceased in a garment they used to wear for salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a recommended ruling regarding the shrouding of the deceased. If possible, a clean garment that the deceased used for salat (prayer) should be included in the shroud, indicating the merit of burying the believer in clothing associated with worship.
